title: Empirical Regime Auditing Under the GCD/UMCP Kernel: Contract-Frozen Calibration, Temporal Diagnostics, Typed Return, and Cross-Stream Evaluation (A Kernel for Empirical Regime Auditing, Version 2.0)
source_native_claims: Separates a fixed measurement kernel for the admitted state of an object from a temporal diagnostic layer for detecting how empirical observations move around that state.
Temporal quantities remain diagnostics unless an explicit closure promotes them; they do not redefine the reserved kernel namespace and do not acquire stance authority through usefulness alone.
Finite return establishes re-entry under the active contract but does not by itself establish a weld, favorable regime, high integrity, or final conformity.
The paper is the technical empirical companion to Liber Collapsus; open seams are aligned to UMCP-KERNEL-SPEC.v2.4.0-rc2 without promoting it.
